_about: The minor Roman historians in J. S. Watson's Bohn translations, raw IA OCR: Justin, Cornelius Nepos and Eutropius (1853); and Sallust, Florus and Velleius Paterculus (1852), taken for Florus and Velleius (Watson's Sallust is already on the sallust shelf from Gutenberg). Latin-facing Loebs of 1930 or earlier added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row); the scan's printing was checked for a post-1930 revision notice where its title verso survives.

florus-forster-nepos-rolfe: Lucius Annaeus Florus, Epitome of Roman History; Cornelius Nepos (Loeb, 1929)
tr. E. S. Forster (Florus), J. C. Rolfe (Nepos)
